description: YouTube transcript and video search API for AI agents: retrieve timestamped transcript segments by video ID or find videos by keyword. Returns JSON transcripts with text, start and duration, or video search results for content research and summarization. Price: 1 prepaid credits per successful call. This tool selects a video transcript and renders compact markdown.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID whose transcript should be returned.
